A Full Floor Flat with View of Golden Gate Bridge, Palace of Fine Arts and the Marin Headlands . . . beautiful interiors w/Hardwood, recently refinished Parquet Floors, Stained Glass Chandeliers and Hand Blown Glass Sconces. 2 wood burning fireplaces. 3300 square foot flat with private interior staircase direct to the enormous, shared back yard which has 2 separate patios and a Greenhouse with Dining Table built in it for garden parties or buffets. Laundry room not shared in basement large enough for home office, home gym equipment, man cave or storage. Many beautiful interior amenities, wood carving, beamed ceilings, pocket doors, french tapestries inset in the walls in one room. Available for viewing by private showing. To inquir call or text to four one five, two eight two, four five hundred. OPTION: annex lower 2ND FLOOR MAKING THIS RESIDENCE 5,500 SQ FT WITH 3 FULL BATHROOMS AND 4 BEDROOMS ($3150) for half the floor or $6000 for entire lower floor. OR solely first floor for $9850 s is it will be 3300 sq ft w/2 bathrooms and view of Golden Gate Bridge :

1 to 5 year lease available 
Pets allowed
No smoking building 
Shared yard and Greenhouse, often used for outdoor dining. Tenants are at liberty to add their own plants or flowers if desired
